prompts.burst_cannon: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite-sheet variant for the EXACT turret in reference image 1. Preserve its design, colors, barrel count, metal bevels and outline style. Create a perfectly regular 3 by 3 grid on a square transparent canvas, with eight turret views and the bottom-right tile empty. Every tile is an equal square, each contains one WHOLE turret, fixed battle camera above the ground (same camera inclination as the reference), same base scale, same lighting, 12% clear margin within each tile. Rotate the turret in ground-plane yaw only; do not tilt or flip the image in the page plane. Eight barrel aim directions in row-major tile order: tile1 NORTH away from viewer, tile2 NORTHEAST upper-right, tile3 EAST right; tile4 SOUTHEAST lower-right, tile5 SOUTH toward viewer, tile6 SOUTHWEST lower-left; tile7 WEST left, tile8 NORTHWEST upper-left; tile9 EMPTY. The three-barrel turret must keep exactly three barrels in every view; the forked turret must keep two prongs and one cyan wedge in every view. Background truly transparent alpha, no grid lines, no captions, no letters, no numbers, no extra items, no cropping. This is a game texture atlas, not a perspective composition of the sheet. Keep all sprites centered and separate.
